lane_center_path — DRIVE lane op

• Datenarten: table × table → table

• Aufruf: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.lane_center_path(left, right, *, lane_width=3.5, samples=51, band_inset=0.2) (die Implementierung direkt: import laneops; laneops.lane_center_path(left, right, *, lane_width=3.5, samples=51, band_inset=0.2); aus dem Register: opsdrive.get("lane_center_path"))

• GPU: nein (nur CPU-Referenzimplementierung)

Verwendung

Gibt aus linker und rechter Begrenzung einen Spurmittelpfad und ein befahrbares Band zurück.

> Die ausführliche Beschreibung unten ist der Originaltext — Zusammenfassung und Überschriften sind übersetzt.

両側があれば共通観測範囲で中点を取る。片側だけなら既知のlane_widthの半分だけ内側へずらし、確信度をSINGLE_BOUNDARY_CONFIDENCE_SCALE倍に下げる。

Parameters

left, right : table or None

lane_boundary_fitの結果。欠測側はNoneか{"valid":False}。

lane_width, samples, band_inset

既知の車線幅[m]、標本数、境界から走行帯を内側へ引く量[m]。両側がある場合も、

観測した幅が既知幅と整合することを検査する。

Returns

table

path(x,y)、band_left/right、閉じたcorridor_polygon、幅、確信度、使用した側。

English: average two fitted boundaries after checking their observed width against the supplied known lane width, or offset a single observed boundary by half the known lane width with reduced confidence. Before a one-sided offset, it rejects a curvature radius no larger than any constructed offset, and rejects a cusp, tangent reversal, or self-intersection with valid=False. It returns the centre path and an inset drivable corridor; it does not check vehicle footprint or obstacles.

呼び出し例::

import numpy as np

import laneops

left = {"coefficients":np.array([-1.75,0.,0.]), "observed_y":np.array([0.,20.]), "confidence":1.}

right = {"coefficients":np.array([1.75,0.,0.]), "observed_y":np.array([0.,20.]), "confidence":1.}

out = laneops.lane_center_path(left, right)

assert np.allclose(out["path"][:, 0], 0.) and np.allclose(out["lane_width_samples"], 3.5)
